text: {"label": "Operant Variability and Response Units", "definition": "Basic and conceptual research on the dimensions of operant behavior, including response variability, bouts and response units, persistence, observing responses, eye movements, and perception of randomness, time and number.", "distinct_from_neighbours": "Studies how operant responses themselves vary, organize and persist, rather than discriminative stimulus control, competing stimulus assessments for applied problems, or derived stimulus equivalence relations."}
